Basic objects ( Lines, circles, arcs )

basic_objects.py: Fundamental 2D geometric primitives with symbolic or numeric coordinates.

Defines Point, LineLike, LineSegment, Line, Ray, Circle, and Arc classes with methods for geometric computations such as distance, angle, slope, and length.

class pygeox.basic_objects.LineLike(point1, point2, name=None)[source]

Bases: object

Base class for geometric entities that are line-like (LineSegment, Line, Ray). Defined by two Point objects.

Parameters:

  • point1 (Point)

  • point2 (Point)

  • name (str | None)

property direction_vector: tuple[int | float | Expr, int | float | Expr]

Returns the direction vector of the ray, from start_point to direction_point.

Returns:

The (dx, dy) vector components.

Return type:

tuple[sympy.Expr, sympy.Expr]

property intercept: int | float | Expr

Returns the y-intercept (c) of the infinite line defined by point1 and point2 (in the form y = mx + c).

Returns:

The y-intercept, or sympy.nan for vertical lines.

Return type:

sympy.Expr

property slope: int | float | Expr

Returns the slope of the infinite line passing through point1 and point2.

Returns:

The slope, or sympy.oo (symbolic infinity) for vertical lines.

Return type:

sympy.Expr

  • signed (bool) – If True, returns the signed angle.

The angle in degrees.

Represents the major arc (larger arc) between two points on a circle.

  • start_point (Point)

The angle in degrees.

Return type:

sympy.Expr

property inscribed_angle

Returns the inscribed angle subtended by the arc in degrees.

The inscribed angle in degrees.

Return type:

sympy.Expr

property length

Returns a non-standard ‘length’ of the major arc, calculated as radius * (angle in degrees).

Returns:

The arc length.

sympy.Expr

Calculates and returns the midpoint of the major arc.

  • name (str, optional) – Name for the midpoint. If None, auto-generated.

Returns:

Point
